description: This PHP class 'gitlabrestInterface' implements an interface for integrating with GitLab's REST API within an issue tracking system. It manages connection setup, issue retrieval, creation, and comments, extending the 'issueTrackerInterface' class, and includes configuration handling and utility functions.

classes.name: gitlabrestInterface
classes.description: A PHP class that provides methods for interacting with GitLab issues, including connection management, retrieving issue data, creating issues, and adding comments. It extends 'issueTrackerInterface' and encapsulates API interactions with GitLab.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the interface, setting configuration and establishing a connection to GitLab.

methods.name: completeCfg
methods.description: Completes configuration setup by setting default attribute values and processing custom fields if provided.

methods.name: getAPIClient
methods.description: Returns the current API client instance used for GitLab API communication.

methods.name: checkBugIDSyntax
methods.description: Checks if the provided bug ID conforms to the expected syntax.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to GitLab API, verifying accessibility by retrieving project data.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Returns whether the connection to GitLab has been successfully established.

methods.name: buildViewBugURL
methods.description: Generates and returns the URL to view a specific issue on GitLab.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific issue from GitLab.

methods.name: getIssueStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the status code of a given issue.

methods.name: getIssueStatusVerbose
methods.description: Retrieves a human-readable status description for an issue.

methods.name: getIssueSummaryHTMLString
methods.description: Returns the HTML string for the issue's summary.

methods.name: checkBugIDExistence
methods.description: Checks if an issue exists on GitLab based on its ID.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Creates a new issue on GitLab with the specified summary and description.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Adds a comment/note to an existing GitLab issue.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template for configuring this GitLab issue tracker integration.

methods.name: canCreateViaAPI
methods.description: Indicates whether issues can be created via the API; returns true.
